theorems.name: Submission.dmcbr_ci_constant_cycle_planes
theorems.statement: ∀ (P d : ℕ) (ν : Measure (Euclid P)) (ζ₀ : MultiVector P (d + 1)) (c : ℝ), 0 < c → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → ν K < ∞) → (∀ β : Covector (Euclid P) (d + 1), |ζ₀ β| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm β) → (∃ β : Covector (Euclid P) (d + 1), covectorEuclideanNorm β ≤ 1 ∧ ζ₀ β = 1) → (∀ φ : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) d, ∫ y, ζ₀ (exteriorDerivative (φ : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) d) y) ∂ν = 0) → (∀ R : ℝ, 0 < R → ν (ball 0 R) ≤ unitBallVolume (d + 1) * ENNReal.ofReal (R ^ (d + 1))) → (∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → 0 < ν (ball 0 r)) → (∀ᵐ y ∂ν, ENNReal.ofReal c ≤ liminf (fun r : ℝ => ν (ball y r) / (unitBallVolume (d + 1) * ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ (d + 1)))) (𝓝[>] 0)) → ∃ (v : Fin (d + 1) → Euclid P) (N : ℕ) (w : Fin N → Euclid P) (α : Fin N → ℝ), Orthonormal ℝ v ∧ (∀ β : Covector (Euclid P) (d + 1), ζ₀ β = β v) ∧ Injective w ∧ (∀ (i : Fin N) (j : Fin (d + 1)), inner ℝ (w i) (v j) = 0) ∧ (∀ i, c ≤ α i) ∧ ∑ i, α i ≤ 1 ∧ (∃ i, w i = 0) ∧ ν = ∑ i, ENNReal.ofReal (α i) • (μHE[(d + 1)]).restrict {y : Euclid P | y - w i ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range v)}
